split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before runtime-corrective owner contract, acceptance suite, runtime acceptance report, generated report, compile artifact, replay manifest, module bundle, native-output proof bundle, linked-probe summary, generated-only row, evidence-log row, migration-only row, runner-only row, or retired-surface claim
split_policy.positive_rule: runtime-corrective rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners; acceptance reports, generated reports, compile artifacts, replay manifests, proof bundles, source-owner contract rows, and provenance rows are not behavior support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: source-owner contract rows, acceptance workload rows, generated reports, required reports, compile artifacts, replay manifests, module bundles, native-output proof bundles, linked-probe summaries, summary/check implementation anchors, authoritative probe paths, authoritative fixture paths, required LL snippets, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, migration-only rows, runner-only rows, cache-only rows, timing-only rows, package-only rows, and counter-only rows are provenance until a phase owner claims the behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: retired-route, gate, compatibility, old-mode, unsupported, unresolved dispatch, strict-error, sidecar-only proof, unlinked probes, generated-evidence-log, evidence-log, migration-only, runner-only, package-only, replay-text-only, catalog-only, and alternate acceptance path claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.evidence_boundary_rule: runtime behavior, runtime public ABI/C API path rows, dispatch semantic model rows, acceptance suite rows, linked probe rows, native output truth rows, generated report rows, and proof bundle rows are distinct evidence classes; only the behavior owner may promote a row to positive support
